recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
habitat: Steep dissected gypsum exposures. Gypsum flora highly dependent on slope and aspect. E-facing slopes dominated by Selaginella and ferns, W-facing slopes open and dominated by Anulocaulis. Only a handful of gypsum endemic plants present: Anulocaulis camporum. Nama carnosum, Sartwellia, Tiquilia, Dicranocarpus parviflorus. Conditions excellent.
locality: N end of Sierra de San Fernando, on Rancho Puerto de Lobos.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”.
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
habitat: Growing in area of undisturbed gypsum as well as gypsum disturbed by recent surface mining. Gypsum exposure, small but remarkably diverse with most of the common gypsum endemic of central Chihuahua present, including Gaillardia turneri, Nerisyrenia gypsophila, Nama carnosum, Dicranocarpus parviflorus, Sartwellia gypsophila, Tiquilia hispidissima, Acleisanthes megaphylla, Phacelia and Drymaria coahuilana. Conditions very good.
locality: W of Coyame along MEX.16, ca. 9 mi. E of jct. with railroad crossing.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner

recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
habitat: In gypsum. Gypsum endemic flora dominated by Tiquilia hispidissima, Gaillardia turneri, Nerisyrenia and  Sartwellia. Conditions good.
locality: Along wash several kilometers N of MEX 16 just S of Sierra El Chino.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner

occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner

locality: On W edge of Sierra Cuchillo Parado.
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner

habitat: Gypsum flats and adjacent gypsum slopes.  Diverse gypsum endemic community dominated by Tiquilia hispidissima, Sartwellia, Nama carnosum, Nerisyrenia gypsophila, etc.  Conditions reasonable.
locality: In hills ca 200 m W of road to Presa El Granero.
name: Sartwellia gypsophila A.M.Powell & B.L.Turner
